verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS product that ships SDKs, a CLI, and an MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to disable telemetry, diagnostic events, or usage tracking. Community notes that apps send evaluation data upstream, and the self-hosted Relay Proxy is an adjacent infrastructure feature rather than an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
